title: Phoenix Art Museum Receives 185 Indigenous Artworks in Major Gift
summary: Arizona’s Phoenix Art Museum, the largest art museum in the American Southwest, has received a gift of 185 works made by Indigenous artists from the William P. Healey Collection of Native American Art, the institution announced on June 2nd.
